summary: ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) containing Hong Kong Exchange Next Day Disclosure Returns and a monthly securities-movement return, disclosing on-market buybacks of American depositary shares, each ADS representing one Class A ordinary share. Detailed repurchases span August 12–21, 2026 at prices from USD 21.32 to USD 23.00 per ADS, totaling roughly 1.38 million ADSs; the issued-share balance held at 557,330,906 Class A shares. No board recommendation, advisor, premium or regulatory clock is stated, as these are routine open-market repurchases under an existing program. What to watch: pace and pricing versus prior buybacks and any new mandate authorizing further repurchases.
